page: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-2 is a general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor clocked at 2.2 GHz. The instance features 1 physical CPU core with 2 thread-based virtual CPUs, accompanied by 8.0 GB of RAM, yielding a standard core-to-memory allocation ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisions include 32 KB L1d cache, 0.25 MB L2 cache, and 55 MB L3 cache. It incorporates instruction set flags including AVX, AES, FMA, BMI2, and ADX, while lacking AVX-512 capabilities. This configuration offers dedicated CPU allocation, includes no integrated local NVMe SSD storage, and contains no dedicated GPU hardware acceleration.

Synthetic benchmark measurements reflect entry-level performance characteristics across compute and memory subsystems. The single-core stress-ng metric scores 1103.39, while the multi-core stress-ng result reaches 1451.58. PassMark evaluations record a CPU score of 3042.75 alongside an extended instructions score of 1722.27. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 11.77 GB/sec, with write bandwidth measuring 10.27 GB/sec. Application testing reveals a Redis SET rate of 1.35 million operations per second and static web serving throughput of 1.45 GB/sec. Small 135M parameter LLM inference yields 151.83 prompt tokens per second and 64.91 text generation tokens per second.

Given its hardware configuration and benchmark scores, the e2-standard-2 delivers cost-effective resource density for low-intensity cloud services. The balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio supports light web serving, basic microservices, development or staging environments, lightweight internal tools, and administrative utilities. It is less suitable for compute-intensive analytics, large-scale database operations, heavy parallel processing, or high-throughput real-time tasks.
description: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-2 is an entry-level general-purpose instance featuring an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor running at 2.2 GHz with 2 virtual CPUs, 1 physical core, and 8.0 GB of system memory. Equipped with 55 MB L3 cache, AVX extensions, and AES acceleration, the instance omits AVX-512 support, local SSD storage, and GPU processing units. Benchmark testing demonstrates modest execution capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 867.0, multi-core score of 1025.0, static web serving throughput of 1.45 GB/sec, and Redis SET throughput of 1.35 million operations per second. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 11.77 GB/sec. Offering a cost-effective 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the e2-standard-2 is suited for lightweight workloads such as basic web serving, small staging environments, low-traffic microservices, and background administrative applications.
